title: QA run · access-security (31/35) · 5b14b7f3 · 2026-10-19 · 25 PASS / 4 PARTIAL / 2 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 4 NOT-RUN
body:
QA run record for selector `area:access-security` (bare area `access-security` in the title for the roll-up), 18.0 release sweep, plan B (Tier 1 + Tier 2 driven, Tier 3 deferred). Text only — no screenshots; reproduction rules below.

## Environment fingerprint

- framework: `5b14b7f3ad8e2e0786d228772f473d07b36b2477` (objectstack-ai/objectstack, pinned — no pull)
- console: vendored objectui build stamped `4016370af3c9c9dafec2bc5299afd8e8079701b8` (= `.objectui-sha`), built with `pnpm objectui:build`; objectui-only pins run in a checkout at that same sha
- app: examples/app-showcase, canonical boot `OS_PORT=P objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p P -d file:RUN/data.db` with per-item OS_HOME / OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT; package-installing items booted from a scratch copy outside the repo
- ports: each runner its own range (41100–42319), one file DB per item; seed: stock showcase (132 rows) + `--seed-admin`
- run window: 2026-10-19 12:26–13:45 UTC; host: 4 vCPU / 15 GB container shared by up to 7 parallel runners (load average peaked ~40; two boots timed out under load and were re-run serially — no verdict rests on a starved run)
- runner: one dispatching session + parallel runner sub-agents (not sequential); every persona identity proven server-side (`GET /auth/get-session`) before each cell

## Scope

## Reproduction rules for each FAIL

No authentication or authorization hole was found in this area: every gate was driven from both sides with forged requests and held server-side. Both FAILs below are clause-side.

### `access-security.security-catalog-one-holder-and-boot-report` · acceptance[1] — assertion defect

Clause: install-local of a package redeclaring a catalog name → 422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT (or PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED) **with conflicts[]**, nothing recorded.

1. Scratch showcase copy, admin bearer. `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` with an inline manifest whose permission set is named `showcase_member_default`.
2. Expected (clause): 422 carrying `conflicts[]`. Actual (2/2): 422 `{"error":{"code":"PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED","message":"Failed to register imported manifest: …Security catalog name conflict…"}}` — no `conflicts[]`. Refusal itself holds: package list unchanged, nothing cached.

§5 disposition: **assertion defect**. The declared contract (objectql CHANGELOG, fe98cc6) states exactly this: "`install-local`'s offline (inline-manifest) import answers `422` under that route's own `PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED` code, with this refusal's message in `error.message`, and records nothing." `conflicts[]` is declared on the thrown engine error / boot envelope, not on this door. Re-point the clause (or, if the door should forward `conflicts[]`, that is a product decision, not a defect).

### `access-security.share-link-combined-gates` · acceptance[3] — assertion defect (P2)

Clause: "/messages answers identically to /resolve on every call" (status + code pairs).

1. Mint links A (signed-in audience) and B (revoked/expired); call `GET /api/v1/share-links/TOKEN/resolve` and the `/messages` sibling anonymously and as signed-in member C.
2. Actual: open/refuse parity holds (messages opens exactly when resolve opens), but codes differ — anonymous: resolve 401 SIGN_IN_REQUIRED / 404 INVALID_OR_EXPIRED vs messages 404 NOT_FOUND; C on A with password: resolve 200 vs messages 400 UNSUPPORTED (object is not ai_conversations); C without password: resolve 401 NEEDS_PASSWORD vs messages 404 NOT_FOUND.

§5 disposition: **assertion defect** — the divergence is the pinned design (`share-link-envelope.conformance.test.ts`: messages for an unresolvable token → 404 NOT_FOUND; for a non-ai_conversations link → 400 UNSUPPORTED). Re-point to "/messages opens iff /resolve opens".
